name: old asphalt road, mostly flat smooth charcoal like a modern city road: two close base greys in large soft patches with a few worn lighter spots, very sparse 1-2 pixel light aggregate flecks and rare shaded 2-pixel-wide cracks (no lane paint); its unconnected edges are a nearly straight slightly wavy broken rim into dirt, with an occasional bite, chip or short edge crack, and a dry dark-brown ledge on the south side; laid as a road network with crossroads, dead ends and long straight 1-wide and 3-wide runs that mix three edge variants
label: wasteland_ruins/asphalt
